verses.27:21: For a wound can be bound up, and after reviling there is reconciliation; but he who has revealed secrets has lost all hope.
verses.27:22: He who winks with the eye devises evil things, and no one will keep himself away from him.
verses.27:23: Before your eyes he will sweeten your mouth and marvel at your words, but afterward he will twist his mouth and set a stumbling block in your words.
verses.27:24: Many things I have hated, yet I have compared none to him; and the Lord shall hate him.
verses.27:25: He who casts a stone on high casts it upon his own head, and a deceitful blow shall deal out wounds.
verses.27:26: He who digs a pit shall fall into it, and he who sets a snare shall be caught in it.
verses.27:27: He who does evil—it shall roll back upon him, and he shall not know from where it has come to him.
verses.27:28: Mockery and reproach belong to the proud, and vengeance, like a lion, shall lie in wait for him.
verses.27:29: Those who rejoice at the fall of the godly shall be caught in a snare, and anguish shall consume them before their death.
verses.27:30: Rage and wrath—these also are abominations, and a sinful man shall hold fast to them.
verses.28:1: He who takes vengeance shall find vengeance from the Lord, and He will surely keep a strict account of his sins.
verses.28:2: Forgive your neighbor his offense, and then, when you pray, your sins shall be loosed.
verses.28:3: Does one man harbor anger against another, and seek healing from the Lord?
verses.28:4: He has no mercy upon a man like himself, and does he make supplication for his own sins?
verses.28:5: Being flesh himself, he harbors wrath; who shall make atonement for his sins?
verses.28:6: Remember the last things and cease from enmity—corruption and death—and abide in the commandments.
verses.28:7: Remember the commandments, and do not hold wrath against your neighbor; remember the covenant of the Most High, and overlook ignorance.
verses.28:8: Abstain from strife, and you shall diminish sins; for a wrathful man will kindle strife,
verses.28:9: and a sinful man will trouble friends, and casts slander in the midst of those who are at peace.
verses.28:10: According to the fuel of the fire, so shall it burn; according to the strength of a man shall his fury be; and according to his wealth he will heighten his anger, and according to the intensity of the strife it shall be kindled.
verses.28:11: A hasty quarrel kindles a fire, and hasty strife sheds blood.
verses.28:12: If you blow on a spark, it will blaze up; and if you spit upon it, it will be quenched; and both proceed out of your mouth.
verses.28:13: Curse the whisperer and the double-tongued, for they have destroyed many who were at peace.
verses.28:14: A third tongue has shaken many and scattered them from nation to nation; it has pulled down fortified cities and overturned the houses of great men.
verses.28:15: A third tongue has cast out valiant wives and deprived them of their labors.
verses.28:16: He who gives heed to it shall by no means find rest, nor shall he dwell in quietness.
verses.28:17: The stroke of a whip leaves welts, but the stroke of a tongue will crush bones.
verses.28:18: Many have fallen by the edge of the sword, yet not like those who have fallen because of the tongue.
verses.28:19: Blessed is he who is sheltered from it, who has not passed through its fury, who has not drawn its yoke, and has not been bound in its bonds;
verses.28:20: for its yoke is a yoke of iron, and its bonds are bonds of bronze.
verses.28:21: Its death is an evil death, and Hades is more profitable than it.
verses.28:22: It shall by no means prevail over the godly, and in its flame they shall not be burned;
verses.28:23: those who forsake the Lord shall fall into it, and it shall blaze among them and never be quenched; it shall be sent forth upon them like a lion, and like a leopard it shall ravage them.
verses.28:24: Behold, hedge your possession around with thorns; bind up your silver and your gold,
verses.28:25: and make a balance and a weight for your words, and make a door and a bolt for your mouth.
verses.28:26: Take heed lest you somehow slip by it, lest you fall before one who lies in wait.
verses.29:1: He who shows mercy will lend to his neighbor, and he who strengthens with his hand keeps the commandments.
verses.29:2: Lend to your neighbor in the time of his need, and in turn repay your neighbor at the appointed time.
verses.29:3: Keep your word firm and deal faithfully with him, and at every time you shall find what you need.
verses.29:4: Many have regarded a loan as a windfall, and have brought trouble upon those who helped them.
verses.29:5: Until he receives it, he will kiss his hand, and over his neighbor's wealth he will humble his voice; yet at the time of repayment he will draw out the time, and return words of weariness, and blame the times.
verses.29:6: If he is able, he will scarcely recover half, and will reckon it as a windfall; but if not, he has defrauded him of his money, and has gained him as an enemy not for nothing; curses and revilings he will repay him, and instead of honor he will repay him dishonor.
verses.29:7: Many have turned away on account of wickedness; they feared being defrauded for nothing.
verses.29:8: Nevertheless, be patient with a humble man, and you shall draw him toward mercy.
verses.29:9: For the sake of the commandment, help the poor man, and according to his need do not turn him away empty.
verses.29:10: Lose silver for a brother and a friend, and do not let it rust under a stone to ruin.
verses.29:11: Lay up your treasure according to the commandments of the Most High, and it shall profit you more than gold.
verses.29:12: Lock up almsgiving in your storehouses, and it shall deliver you from every affliction;
verses.29:13: more than a shield of might and more than a spear of strength, it shall fight for you against an enemy.
verses.29:14: A good man will become surety for his neighbor, and he who has lost shame will forsake him.
verses.29:15: Do not forget the favors of a surety, for he has given his life for you.
verses.29:16: A sinner will overturn the goods of his surety, and one who is ungrateful in mind will forsake his deliverer.
verses.29:17: Suretyship has ruined many who were prospering and tossed them like a wave of the sea; it has uprooted mighty men, and they wandered among foreign nations.
verses.29:19: A sinner who falls into suretyship and pursues business contracts shall fall into lawsuits.
verses.29:20: Help your neighbor according to your ability, and take heed to yourself lest you fall.
verses.29:21: The first essential of life is water and bread and a garment, and a house covering shame.
verses.29:22: Better is the life of a poor man under a shelter of rafters than sumptuous fare among strangers.
verses.29:23: With little or with much, be content.
verses.29:24: It is a miserable life to go from house to house, and wherever he sojourns he will not open his mouth;
verses.29:25: you will entertain and give drink without thanks, and in addition to these things you shall hear bitter words:
verses.29:26: "Come forward, sojourner, set the table, and if there is anything in your hand, feed me."
verses.29:27: "Depart, sojourner, from the presence of honor; my brother has come as my guest, and there is need of the lodging."
verses.29:28: These things are grievous to a man who has understanding: the rebuke of a household and the reproach of a creditor.
verses.30:1: Concerning children: He who loves his son will continually apply lashes to him, that he may rejoice in his latter end.
verses.30:2: He who disciplines his son will profit by him, and in the midst of acquaintances he will boast of him.
verses.30:3: He who teaches his son will provoke the enemy to jealousy, and before friends he will exult in him.
verses.30:4: His father has died, and it is as though he has not died, for he has left behind one like himself after him.
verses.30:5: In his lifetime he saw and rejoiced, and at his death he was not grieved;
verses.30:6: against enemies he left behind an avenger, and to friends one who repays favor.
verses.30:7: Concerning the lives of sons he will bind up his wounds, and at every cry his inward parts will be troubled.
verses.30:8: An untamed horse turns out stubborn, and an unrestrained son turns out headstrong.
verses.30:9: Pamper a child, and he will terrify you; play with him, and he will grieve you.
verses.30:10: Do not laugh with him, lest you suffer grief with him, and in the end you will gnash your teeth.
verses.30:11: Do not give him authority in youth.
verses.30:12: Bruise his sides while he is a young child, lest he become hardened and disobey you.
verses.30:13: Discipline your son and labor with him, lest he stumble in your disgrace.
verses.30:14: Better is a poor man who is healthy and strong in constitution than a rich man scourged in his body.
verses.30:15: Health and vigor are better than all gold, and a strong body than measureless wealth.
verses.30:16: There is no wealth better than health of body, and there is no gladness above joy of heart.
verses.30:17: Better is death than a bitter life or a lingering sickness.
verses.30:18: Good things poured out upon a closed mouth are like offerings of food set upon a grave.
verses.30:19: What does a burnt offering profit an idol? For it will neither eat nor smell; so is he who is pursued by the Lord,
verses.30:20: seeing with his eyes and groaning, like a eunuch embracing a virgin and groaning.
verses.30:21: Do not give your soul over to sorrow, and do not afflict yourself by your own counsel.
verses.30:22: Gladness of heart is the life of a man, and the exultation of a man is length of days.
verses.30:23: Love your own soul and comfort your heart, and put sorrow far away from you; for sorrow has slain many, and there is no profit in it.
verses.30:24: Jealousy and wrath shorten days, and anxiety brings old age before its time.
verses.30:25: A cheerful and good heart will attend to its food at meals.
verses.31:1: Sleeplessness over wealth wastes away the flesh, and anxiety over it drives away sleep.
verses.31:2: Wakeful anxiety banishes slumber, and a severe sickness dispels sleep.
verses.31:3: The rich man toils in the gathering of riches, and when he rests, he is filled with his luxuries;
verses.31:4: the poor man toils in scarcity of livelihood, and when he rests, he becomes needy.
verses.31:5: He who loves gold will not be justified, and he who pursues corruption will himself be filled.
verses.31:6: Many have been given over to ruin for the sake of gold, and their destruction came before their face.
verses.31:7: It is a stumbling block to those who sacrifice to it, and every fool will be caught in it.
verses.31:8: Blessed is the rich man who is found blameless, and who has not walked after gold.
verses.31:9: Who is he, and we will call him blessed? For he has done wondrous things among his people.
verses.31:10: Who has been tested by it and proven perfect? Let it be a cause for boasting! Who was able to transgress and did not transgress, and to do evil and did not do it?
verses.31:11: His goods will be established, and the assembly will declare his charitable deeds.
verses.31:12: Have you sat down at a great table? Do not open your throat wide over it, and do not say, "Many indeed are the things upon it!"
verses.31:13: Remember that an evil eye is a wicked thing; what has been created more evil than an eye? Therefore it sheds tears from every face.
verses.31:14: Wherever he looks, do not stretch out your hand, and do not crowd with him in the dish.
verses.31:15: Understand the concerns of your neighbor from yourself, and be thoughtful in every matter.
verses.31:16: Eat like a man what is set before you, and do not chew greedily, lest you be despised.
verses.31:17: Be the first to stop for the sake of discipline, and do not be insatiable, lest you give offense.
verses.31:18: And if you are seated in the midst of many, do not stretch out your hand before them.
verses.31:19: How sufficient is a little to a well-disciplined man! Upon his bed he does not gasp for breath.
verses.31:20: Healthy sleep comes with a moderate stomach; he rises early, and his soul is with him. The distress of sleeplessness, bilious sickness, and griping pain are with an insatiable man.
verses.31:21: And if you have been pressed too hard with foods, rise up and step away, and you will find relief.
verses.31:22: Listen to me, child, and do not despise me, and in the end you will find my words true. In all your works be diligent, and no sickness shall ever come upon you.
verses.31:23: Lips will bless him who is generous with bread, and the testimony to his nobility is trustworthy;
verses.31:24: against him who is grudging with bread the city will murmur, and the testimony to his stinginess is exact.
verses.31:25: Do not show your valor in wine, for wine has destroyed many.
verses.31:26: The furnace tests the tempered steel in the quenching; so does wine test hearts in the strife of the proud.
verses.31:27: Wine is equal to life for a man, if you drink it in its measure. What is life to one who is deprived of wine? For it was created for the gladness of men.
verses.31:28: Exultation of heart and gladness of soul is wine drunk at the right time and in moderate measure;
verses.31:29: bitterness of soul is wine drunk in excess, with provocation and downfall.
verses.31:30: Drunkenness increases the wrath of a fool to his stumbling, diminishing strength and adding wounds.
verses.31:31: At a banquet of wine do not rebuke your neighbor, and do not despise him in his gladness; do not speak a word of reproach to him, and do not distress him by demanding a debt.
verses.32:1: Have they appointed you as leader? Do not exalt yourself; be among them as one of them. Take care of them, and then sit down.
verses.32:2: And when you have fulfilled all your duty, recline, that you may rejoice on their account and receive a crown for good order.
verses.32:3: Speak, O elder, for it is fitting for you—with exact knowledge—and do not hinder the music.
verses.32:4: Where there is entertainment, do not pour out speech, and do not make a show of wisdom out of season.
verses.32:5: A signet of carbuncle upon an ornament of gold, such is a concert of music at a banquet of wine.
verses.32:6: A signet of emerald in a setting of gold, such is a melody of music with sweet wine.
verses.32:7: Speak, O young man, if there is need of you, yet scarcely twice, if you are questioned.
verses.32:8: Sum up your speech, much in few words; be as one who knows and at the same time keeps silent.
verses.32:9: In the midst of great men do not make yourself their equal, and when another is speaking, do not chatter much.
verses.32:10: Before thunder the lightning hastens, and before a modest man favor shall go forth.
verses.32:11: Rise up at the proper hour and do not lag behind; hasten home and do not linger.
verses.32:12: There take your pleasure and do what you have in mind, yet do not sin by an arrogant word.
verses.32:13: And for these things bless Him who made you, and who satisfies you abundantly from His good things.
verses.32:14: He who fears the Lord will accept discipline, and those who rise early shall find favor.
verses.32:15: He who seeks the law shall be filled with it, but he who plays the hypocrite shall stumble in it.
verses.32:16: Those who fear the Lord shall find justice, and shall kindle righteous decrees like a light.
verses.32:17: A sinful man will turn aside from reproof, and according to his own will he will find a precedent.
verses.32:18: A man of counsel will by no means overlook a thought, but a strange and arrogant man will not shrink back in fear, even after acting on his own without counsel.
verses.32:19: Without counsel do nothing, and once you have acted, do not regret it.
verses.32:20: Do not walk on a path of stumbling, and do not stumble in stony places.
verses.32:21: Do not put your trust in an unobstructed road,
verses.32:22: and guard yourself against your children.
verses.32:23: In every work trust your own soul, for this also is the keeping of the commandments.
verses.32:24: He who trusts in the law gives heed to the commandments, and he who relies upon the Lord shall suffer no loss.
verses.33:1: No evil shall befall him who fears the Lord, but in trial He will deliver him again and again.
verses.33:2: A wise man will not hate the law, but he who plays the hypocrite in it is like a ship in a tempest.
verses.33:3: A man of understanding will trust in the law, and the law is trustworthy to him as an inquiry of the righteous.
verses.33:4: Prepare your speech, and so you shall be heard; bind together instruction, and then answer.
verses.33:5: The heart of a fool is like a cart wheel, and his reasoning is like a turning axle.
verses.33:6: A stallion is like a mocking friend; beneath everyone who sits upon him he neighs.
verses.33:7: Why does one day excel another, when all the light of every day of the year is from the sun?
verses.33:8: By the knowledge of the Lord they were separated, and He varied seasons and feasts.
verses.33:9: Some of them He exalted and sanctified, and some of them He set into the number of days.
verses.33:10: And all men are from the ground, and out of the earth Adam was created.
verses.33:11: In fullness of knowledge the Lord separated them, and He varied their ways.
verses.33:12: Some of them He blessed and exalted, and some of them He sanctified and brought near to Himself; some of them He cursed and brought low, and overturned them from their station.
verses.33:13: As the potter's clay is in his hand—all its ways are according to his good pleasure—so are men in the hand of Him who made them, to render to them according to His judgment.
verses.33:14: Opposite evil is good, and opposite death is life; so opposite the godly is the sinner.
verses.33:15: And so look upon all the works of the Most High: two by two, one opposite the other.
verses.33:17: As one who gleans behind the grape gatherers, by the blessing of the Lord I got ahead,
verses.33:18: and like a grape gatherer I filled a winepress. Consider that I have not labored for myself alone, but for all those who seek instruction.
verses.33:19: Hear me, O great men of the people, and you rulers of the assembly, give ear.
verses.33:20: To son and wife, to brother and friend, do not give authority over you during your life; and do not give your possessions to another, lest you regret it and have to beg for them.
verses.33:21: While you still live and breath is in you, do not give yourself in exchange to any flesh.
verses.33:22: For it is better that your children should ask of you than that you should look to the hands of your sons.
verses.33:23: In all your works remain preeminent; do not bring a blemish upon your honor.
verses.33:24: In the day of the completion of the days of your life, and at the time of your end, distribute your inheritance.
verses.33:25: Fodder and a rod and burdens for a donkey; bread and discipline and work for a servant.
verses.33:26: Keep a servant at work, and you shall find rest; leave his hands idle, and he will seek liberty.
verses.33:27: Yoke and thong will bow the neck, and for an evildoing servant there are racks and torments.
verses.33:28: Put him to work, that he may not be idle, for idleness teaches much wickedness.
verses.33:29: Set him to tasks as is fitting for him, and if he does not obey, make his fetters heavy.
verses.33:30: Yet do not go to excess with any flesh, and without judgment do nothing.
verses.33:31: If you have a servant, let him be as yourself, because you bought him with blood.
verses.33:32: If you have a servant, treat him as yourself, for you have need of him as of your own soul; if you mistreat him and he departs and runs away, on what road will you search for him?
verses.34:1: Empty and false hopes belong to a man without understanding, and dreams give wings to fools.
verses.34:2: Like one who grasps at a shadow and pursues the wind, so is he who pays heed to dreams.
verses.34:3: The vision of dreams is this over against that, the likeness of a face over against a face.
verses.34:4: From what is unclean, what shall be cleansed? And from what is false, what shall prove true?
verses.34:5: Divinations and omens and dreams are vain, and like one in travail the heart forms imaginations.
verses.34:6: Unless they are sent from the Most High in a visitation, do not give your heart to them.
verses.34:7: Dreams have led many astray, and those who put their hope in them have fallen.
verses.34:8: Without falsehood the law shall be fulfilled, and wisdom in a faithful mouth is perfection.
verses.34:9: A well-instructed man knows many things, and a man of much experience will declare understanding.
verses.34:10: He who has not been tested knows little, but he who has traveled widely will multiply shrewdness.
verses.34:11: I have seen many things in my travels, and my understanding is greater than my words.
verses.34:12: Many times I was in peril even to death, and I was delivered on account of these things.
verses.34:13: The spirit of those who fear the Lord shall live, for their hope is in Him who saves them.
verses.34:14: He who fears the Lord shall never be terrified and shall never lose heart, for He is his hope.
verses.34:15: Blessed is the soul of him who fears the Lord! To whom does he look, and who is his support?
verses.34:16: The eyes of the Lord are upon those who love Him—a mighty defense and a strong support, a shelter from scorching heat and a shade from noonday, a guard against stumbling and a help against falling.
verses.34:17: He lifts up the soul and enlightens the eyes, giving healing, life, and blessing.
verses.34:18: If one sacrifices from what is unjustly gained, the offering is a mockery, and the mockeries of the lawless are not acceptable.
verses.34:19: The Most High is not pleased with the offerings of the ungodly, nor does He forgive sins for a multitude of sacrifices.
verses.34:20: Like one who slays a son before his father is he who brings a sacrifice from the goods of the poor.
verses.34:21: The bread of the needy is the life of the poor; he who deprives them of it is a man of blood.
verses.34:22: He murders his neighbor who takes away his livelihood, and he sheds blood who deprives a hired laborer of his wages.
verses.34:23: When one builds and another tears down, what have they profited beyond toil?
verses.34:24: When one prays and another curses, whose voice will the Master hear?
verses.34:25: If a man washes himself because of a dead body and touches it again, what has he profited by his washing?
verses.34:26: So it is with a man who fasts for his sins and goes again and does the same things: who will hear his prayer, and what has he profited by humbling himself?
verses.35:1: He who keeps the law multiplies offerings; he who heeds the commandments offers a peace offering.
verses.35:2: He who repays a kindness offers fine flour, and he who gives alms offers a sacrifice of praise.
verses.35:3: To depart from wickedness is the good pleasure of the Lord, and to turn away from unrighteousness is an atonement.
verses.35:4: Do not appear before the face of the Lord empty-handed, for all these things are on account of the commandment.
verses.35:5: The offering of a righteous man enriches the altar, and its sweet aroma is before the Most High.
verses.35:6: The sacrifice of a righteous man is acceptable, and its memorial shall not be forgotten.
verses.35:7: With a generous eye glorify the Lord, and do not diminish the firstfruits of your hands.
verses.35:8: In every gift make your countenance cheerful, and with gladness consecrate the tithe.
verses.35:9: Give to the Most High according to His gift, and with a generous eye according to what your hand has found.
verses.35:10: For the Lord is One who repays, and He will repay you sevenfold.
verses.35:12: Do not offer a bribe, for He will not accept it; and do not trust in an unrighteous sacrifice, for the Lord is Judge, and with Him there is no partiality.
verses.35:13: He will not show partiality against a poor man, and He will listen to the supplication of the one who has been wronged.
verses.35:14: He will by no means disregard the plea of the fatherless, nor the widow when she pours out her complaint.
verses.35:15: Do not the tears of the widow run down her cheek, and is not her outcry against him who makes them fall?
verses.35:16: He who serves in good pleasure shall be accepted, and his supplication shall reach to the clouds.
verses.35:17: The prayer of the humble pierces the clouds, and until it draws near he will not be comforted; and he will not depart until the Most High visits,
verses.35:21: and judges righteously and executes judgment. And the Lord will not delay, nor will He be patient with them, until He crushes the loins of the merciless and repays vengeance to the nations; until He takes away the multitude of the insolent and shatters the scepters of the unrighteous;
verses.35:22: until He repays man according to his deeds and the works of men according to their intentions; until He judges the cause of His people and makes them rejoice in His mercy.
verses.35:24: Timely is mercy in the time of their affliction, like clouds of rain in a time of drought.
verses.36:1: Have mercy upon us, O Master, God of all, and look upon us, and cast Your fear upon all the nations.
verses.36:2: Lift up Your hand against foreign nations, and let them see Your mighty power.
verses.36:3: Just as You were sanctified in us before them, so be magnified in them before us;
verses.36:4: and let them know You, just as we also have known, that there is no God besides You, O Lord.
verses.36:5: Renew signs and work fresh wonders.
verses.36:6: Glorify Your hand and Your right arm; arouse fury and pour out wrath; remove the adversary and wipe out the enemy.
verses.36:7: Hasten the time and remember the oath, and let them declare Your mighty deeds.
verses.36:8: Let him who escapes be consumed in the wrath of fire, and may those who wrong Your people find destruction.
verses.36:9: Crush the heads of the enemy rulers who say, "There is none besides us."
verses.36:10: Gather all the tribes of Jacob—I also, the last, kept watch—and You shall give them their inheritance, as from the beginning.
verses.36:11: Have mercy, O Lord, upon the people called by Your name, and upon Israel, whom You have likened to a firstborn.
verses.36:12: Have compassion on the city of Your sanctuary, Jerusalem, the city of Your rest.
verses.36:13: Fill Zion with the praise of Your mighty deeds, and Your people with Your glory.
verses.36:14: Give testimony to those You created in the beginning, and raise up the prophecies spoken in Your name.
verses.36:15: Give reward to those who wait for You, and let Your prophets be proved trustworthy.
verses.36:16: Hear, O Lord, the supplication of Your suppliants, according to the blessing of Aaron concerning Your people; and all who are upon the earth shall know that You are the Lord, the God of the ages.
verses.36:18: The stomach will eat every kind of food, yet one food is better than another.
verses.36:19: The palate tastes foods of the hunt; so an understanding heart discerns false words.
verses.36:20: A perverse heart will bring grief, but a man of much experience will repay him.
verses.36:21: A woman will accept any man, yet one daughter is better than another.
verses.36:22: The beauty of a woman brightens the countenance, and it surpasses every desire of man.
verses.36:23: If mercy and gentleness are upon her tongue, her husband is not like other sons of men.
verses.36:24: He who acquires a wife makes the beginning of a possession—a helper suited to him and a pillar of rest.
verses.36:25: Where there is no hedge, the property will be plundered; and where there is no wife, a man will groan as a wanderer.
verses.36:26: For who will trust a nimble robber who roams from city to city? So it is with a man who has no nest and lodges wherever evening overtakes him.
verses.37:1: Every friend will say, "I also have been a friend to him"; yet there is a friend who is a friend in name only.
verses.37:2: Is there not a grief even to death when a companion and friend turns to enmity?
verses.37:3: O wicked imagination, from where were you rolled in to cover the dry land with deceit?
verses.37:4: A companion delights in a friend's gladness, and in a time of affliction he will stand against him;
verses.37:5: a companion labors with a friend for the sake of the belly; in the face of battle he will take up a shield.
verses.37:6: Do not forget a friend in your soul, and do not be unmindful of him in your wealth.
verses.37:7: Every counselor extols counsel, yet there is one who gives counsel for himself.
verses.37:8: Guard your soul from a counselor, and know beforehand what his need is—for he also will counsel for himself—lest he cast a lot against you,
verses.37:9: and say to you, "Your way is good," and he will stand opposite to see what will befall you.
verses.37:10: Do not take counsel with him who looks suspiciously at you, and hide counsel from those who envy you:
verses.37:11: with a woman concerning her rival, and with a coward concerning war, and with a merchant concerning exchange, and with a buyer concerning a sale, with a grudging man concerning gratitude, and with a merciless man concerning kindness, with a slothful man concerning any work, and with an outside hireling concerning the completion of a task, or with an idle household servant concerning much labor—do not rely on these for any counsel.
verses.37:12: Rather, remain continually with a godly man, whom you recognize as keeping the commandments, who in his soul is like your own soul, and if you stumble, he will grieve with you.
verses.37:13: And establish the counsel of your heart, for there is no one more faithful to you than it;
verses.37:14: for a man's soul is sometimes accustomed to report better than seven watchmen sitting on high upon a watchtower.
verses.37:15: And above all these things, pray to the Most High that He may direct your way in truth.
verses.37:16: The beginning of every work is a word, and before every deed is counsel.
verses.37:17: The trace of alteration is in the heart:
verses.37:18: four parts spring forth—good and evil, life and death—and that which continually rules over them is the tongue.
verses.37:19: There is a shrewd man and an instructor of many, and yet to his own soul he is useless.
verses.37:20: There is one who makes a show of wisdom in words and is hated; this man shall be destitute of all nourishment,
verses.37:21: for grace was not given to him from the Lord, because he was deprived of all wisdom.
verses.37:22: There is one who is wise for his own soul, and the fruits of his understanding upon the mouth are trustworthy.
verses.37:23: A wise man will instruct his own people, and the fruits of his understanding are trustworthy.
verses.37:24: A wise man shall be filled with blessing, and all who behold him will call him blessed.
verses.37:25: The life of a man is in a number of days, and the days of Israel are innumerable.
verses.37:26: The wise man among his people shall inherit confidence, and his name shall live forever.
verses.37:27: Child, in your life test your soul, and see what is harmful to it, and do not give that to it;
verses.37:28: for not all things are profitable for all, and not every soul takes pleasure in everything.
verses.37:29: Do not be insatiable in any delicacy, and do not pour yourself out over foods;
verses.37:30: for in many foods there shall be pain, and insatiability will draw near even to bilious sickness;
verses.37:31: because of insatiability many have died, but he who takes heed will add to his life.
verses.38:1: Honor a physician according to the need of him with his due honors, for the Lord indeed created him;
verses.38:2: for healing comes from the Most High, and from a king he shall receive a gift.
verses.38:3: The skill of a physician shall lift up his head, and in the presence of great men he shall be held in wonder.
verses.38:4: The Lord created medicines out of the earth, and a prudent man will not loathe them.
verses.38:5: Was not water made sweet by wood, that His power might be made known?
verses.38:6: And He Himself gave men knowledge, to be glorified in His wondrous works;
verses.38:7: by them he heals and removes his pain,
verses.38:8: with these the apothecary will make a compound; and He will never bring His works to an end, and peace from Him is upon the face of the earth.
verses.38:9: Child, in your sickness do not be negligent, but pray to the Lord, and He Himself will heal you;
verses.38:10: put away transgression and make your hands upright, and cleanse your heart from all sin;
verses.38:11: offer a sweet aroma and a memorial of fine flour, and make the offering rich, as one who is no more.
verses.38:12: And give place to the physician, for the Lord indeed created him; and let him not depart from you, for indeed there is need of him.
verses.38:13: There is a time when success is indeed in their hands;
verses.38:14: for they also will pray to the Lord, that He may prosper for them relief and healing for the preservation of life.
verses.38:15: He who sins before Him who made him—may he fall into the hands of a physician!
verses.38:16: Child, let tears fall over the dead, and as one suffering grievously begin a lament; and according to his due shroud his body, and do not neglect his burial.
verses.38:17: Make your weeping bitter and your wailing fervent, and observe mourning according to his worth for one day and two because of slander, and then be comforted on account of grief;
verses.38:18: for out of grief comes death, and grief of heart will bow down strength.
verses.38:19: In affliction grief also goes alongside, and the life of a poor man is against the heart.
verses.38:20: Do not give your heart over to grief; put it away, remembering the end.
verses.38:21: Do not forget, for there is no returning; you will do him no good, and you will harm yourself.
verses.38:22: Remember that his sentence is even as yours: "For me yesterday, and for you today."
verses.38:23: At the resting of the dead, let his remembrance rest, and be comforted concerning him at the departure of his spirit.
verses.38:24: The wisdom of a scribe comes through opportunity of leisure, and he who has less of business shall become wise.
verses.38:25: How shall he become wise who holds the plow and boasts in the shaft of the goad, driving oxen and occupied in their works, while their discourse is of young bulls?
verses.38:26: He will set his heart to turn furrows, and his sleepless care is for the fodder of heifers.
verses.38:27: So also is every craftsman and master builder, who passes the night as the day; so are those who engrave the carvings of signets, and his perseverance is to vary the intricate pattern; he will set his heart to make a lifelike painting, and his sleepless care is to complete the work.
verses.38:28: So also is the smith sitting near the anvil and studying the unwrought iron; the vapor of the fire will harden his flesh, and in the heat of the furnace he will contend; the sound of the hammer will continually renew his ear, and his eyes are upon the pattern of the vessel; he will set his heart to finish his works, and his sleepless care is to adorn them to completion.
verses.38:29: So also is the potter sitting at his work and turning the wheel with his feet, who is continually burdened with anxiety over his work, and all his labor is counted by number;
verses.38:30: with his arm he will fashion the clay, and before his feet he will bend its stiffness; he will apply his heart to finish the gift, and his sleepless care is to cleanse the kiln.
verses.38:31: All these have put their trust in their hands, and each one is wise in his own work.
verses.38:32: Without them a city shall not be inhabited, nor shall men sojourn or walk about;
verses.38:33: and in the assembly they shall not rise to eminence, nor shall they understand the covenant of judgment; they shall not sit upon the judge's seat, nor shall they declare righteousness and judgment, and among parables they shall not be found;
verses.38:34: but they shall uphold the fabric of the age, and their prayer is in the practice of their craft. Not so with him who devotes his soul and meditates in the law of the Most High,
verses.39:1: He shall seek out the wisdom of all the ancients, and shall be occupied in prophecies.
verses.39:2: He shall preserve the discourses of men of renown, and shall enter into the subtleties of parables.
verses.39:3: He shall seek out the hidden things of proverbs, and shall be conversant with the riddles of parables.
verses.39:4: He shall serve in the midst of great men, and shall appear before a ruler; he shall pass through the land of foreign nations, for he has tested good and evil among men.
verses.39:5: He shall give his heart to rise early to the Lord who made him, and shall make supplication before the Most High; he shall open his mouth in prayer, and shall make supplication for his sins.
verses.39:6: If the great Lord wills, he shall be filled with the spirit of understanding; he himself shall pour forth words of wisdom, and in prayer he shall give thanks to the Lord.
verses.39:7: He himself shall direct his counsel and knowledge, and shall meditate upon His hidden things.
verses.39:8: He displays the discipline of his instruction, and shall glory in the law of the covenant of the Lord.
verses.39:9: Many shall praise his understanding, and forever it shall not be blotted out; his memorial shall not depart, and his name shall live to generations of generations.
verses.39:10: Nations shall recount his wisdom, and the assembly shall proclaim his praise.
verses.39:11: If he remains, he shall leave a name greater than a thousand; and if he rests, it suffices for him.
verses.39:12: Having meditated yet further, I will declare it, for like the full moon I have been filled.
verses.39:13: Listen to me, O holy sons, and bud forth like a rose growing by a stream of the field,
verses.39:14: and like frankincense send forth a sweet aroma, and put forth a blossom like a lily; spread abroad a fragrance and sing a song of praise. Bless the Lord for all the works,
verses.39:15: give greatness to His name, and give thanks in His praise, with songs of the lips and with harps; and thus you shall say in thanksgiving:
verses.39:16: "All the works of the Lord are exceedingly good, and every command shall come to pass in its time.
verses.39:17: One must not say, 'What is this? Why is this?' for everything shall be sought out in its time. At His word the water stood as a heap, and at the utterance of His mouth the reservoirs of waters.
verses.39:18: At His command is all good pleasure, and there is no one who shall diminish His salvation.
verses.39:19: The works of all flesh are before Him, and it is not possible to be hidden from His eyes.
verses.39:20: From everlasting to everlasting He looks, and nothing is astonishing before Him.
verses.39:21: One must not say, 'What is this? Why is this?' for all things have been created for their uses.
verses.39:22: His blessing has covered over like a river, and like a flood has drenched the dry land;
verses.39:23: so shall the nations inherit His wrath, just as He turned waters into brine.
verses.39:24: His ways are straight for the holy, even so they are stumbling blocks for the lawless.
verses.39:25: Good things were created for the good from the beginning, even so evil things for sinners.
verses.39:26: The foremost of every need for the life of man are water, fire, and iron, and salt, and fine flour, wheat, and honey, and milk, the blood of the grape, and oil, and clothing.
verses.39:27: All these things are for good to the godly; even so to sinners they shall be turned into evil.
verses.39:28: There are spirits that were created for vengeance, and in their fury they have made firm their scourges; and in the time of consummation they shall pour forth strength, and shall appease the wrath of Him who made them.
verses.39:29: Fire and hail, and famine and death—all these were created for vengeance;
verses.39:30: the teeth of wild beasts, and scorpions, and vipers, and a sword executing vengeance upon the ungodly to destruction;
verses.39:31: in His commandment they shall rejoice, and upon the earth they shall be made ready for needs, and in their seasons they shall not transgress the word."
verses.39:32: Therefore from the beginning I was firmly convinced, and I meditated, and I left it in writing.
verses.39:33: All the works of the Lord are good, and He shall supply every need in its hour.
verses.39:34: And one must not say, "This is worse than that," for all things shall be approved in due time.
verses.39:35: And now with all heart and mouth we have sung praise; and bless the name of the Lord.
verses.40:1: Great travail has been created for every man, and a heavy yoke is upon the sons of Adam, from the day of their coming forth from their mother's womb until the day of burial into the mother of all:
verses.40:2: their anxious thoughts and fear of heart, the brooding of expectation, the day of death—
verses.40:3: from him who sits upon a throne in glory, even to him who is humbled in earth and ashes,
verses.40:4: from him who wears blue-purple and a crown, even to him who is wrapped in coarse linen—
verses.40:5: wrath and jealousy, and turmoil and unrest, and fear of death, and resentment, and strife. And in the time of rest upon his bed, the sleep of night alters his mind.
verses.40:6: Little, as nothing, is he at rest; and afterward in his sleep he is as on a day of keeping watch, troubled in the vision of his heart, like one who has escaped from the face of battle.
verses.40:7: At the moment of his deliverance he awakes, marveling that there was nothing to fear.
verses.40:8: So it is with all flesh, from man to beast, and upon sinners sevenfold more than these:
verses.40:9: death and bloodshed, and strife and the sword;
verses.40:10: against the lawless all these things were created, and because of them the flood came to pass.
verses.40:11: All things that are from the earth return to the earth, and what is from the waters turns back to the sea.
verses.40:12: Every bribe and injustice shall be blotted out, and faithfulness shall stand forever.
verses.40:13: The wealth of the unrighteous shall dry up like a river, and like great thunder in rain it shall resound.
verses.40:14: When he opens his hands, he shall rejoice; even so transgressors shall utterly fail.
verses.40:15: The offspring of the ungodly shall not multiply branches, and unclean roots are upon a sheer rock.
verses.40:16: The reed by every water and riverbank shall be plucked up before all grass.
verses.40:17: Kindness is like a paradise in blessings, and almsgiving shall abide forever.
verses.40:18: The life of a self-sufficient laborer shall be made sweet, yet above both is he who finds a treasure.
verses.40:19: Children and the building of a city establish a name, yet above both a blameless wife is esteemed.
verses.40:20: Wine and music gladden the heart, yet above both is the love of wisdom.
verses.40:21: The flute and the harp make melodies sweet, yet above both is a sweet tongue.
verses.40:22: Your eye shall desire grace and beauty, yet above both the green shoots of sown grain.
verses.40:23: A friend and a companion meet in due season, yet above both is a wife with her husband.
verses.40:24: Brethren and help are for a time of affliction, yet above both almsgiving shall deliver.
verses.40:25: Gold and silver shall make the foot stand firm, yet above both a wife is esteemed.
verses.40:26: Wealth and strength shall lift up the heart, yet above both is the fear of the Lord; in the fear of the Lord there is no lack, and in it there is no need to seek for help.
verses.40:27: The fear of the Lord is like a paradise of blessing, and above all glory they have covered it.
verses.40:28: Child, do not live a life of begging; it is better to die than to beg.
verses.40:29: A man who looks to another's table—his existence is not in the reckoning of life; he shall defile his soul with another's food, but a man of understanding and discipline shall guard himself.
verses.40:30: In the mouth of the shameless, begging shall be sweet, yet in his belly a fire shall burn.
verses.41:1: O death, how bitter is the remembrance of you to a man who lives in peace among his possessions, to a man free from distraction and prospering in all things, and still strong enough to receive food!
verses.41:2: O death, good is your decree to a man who is needy and diminishing in strength, in extreme old age and anxious about all things, who is defiant and has lost endurance.
verses.41:3: Do not dread the decree of death; remember those who went before you and those who come after. This is the decree from the Lord for all flesh,
verses.41:4: and why do you refuse the good pleasure of the Most High? Whether ten, or a hundred, or a thousand years, there is no reckoning of life in Hades.
verses.41:5: The children of sinners become abominable children, and frequent the habitations of the ungodly.
verses.41:6: The inheritance of the children of sinners shall perish, and with their offspring reproach shall continually abide.
verses.41:7: Children will blame an ungodly father, because on account of him they will suffer reproach.
verses.41:8: Woe to you, ungodly men, who have forsaken the law of the Most High God!
verses.41:9: And if you are born, to a curse you shall be born; and if you die, to a curse you shall be apportioned.
verses.41:10: All things that come from the earth shall go back to the earth; so the ungodly go from a curse to destruction.
verses.41:11: The mourning of men is over their bodies, but the name of sinners, which is not good, shall be blotted out.
verses.41:12: Take care for your name, for it shall endure for you longer than a thousand great treasures of gold.
verses.41:13: A good life has its number of days, but a good name shall endure forever.
verses.41:14: Keep instruction in peace, O children; yet hidden wisdom and unseen treasure—what profit is in either of them?
verses.41:15: Better is a man who hides his folly than a man who hides his wisdom.
verses.41:16: Therefore have a proper sense of shame at my word; for it is not good to retain every kind of shame, and not all things are faithfully approved by all.
verses.41:17: Be ashamed before father and mother of fornication, and before a ruler and a mighty man of a lie,
verses.41:19: before a judge and a prince of a trespass, before an assembly and a people of lawlessness, before a partner and a friend of injustice, and before the place where you sojourn of theft,
verses.41:20: and before the truth of God and the covenant, of leaning an elbow upon the bread, of scornful dealing in receiving and giving,
verses.41:21: of silence before those who greet you, of gazing upon a harlot,
verses.41:23: of turning away the face of a kinsman, of taking away a portion and a gift, of looking intently upon a married woman,
verses.41:25: of meddling with his maidservant—and do not approach her bed; before friends of words of reproach—and after you have given, do not reproach;
verses.41:27: of repeating and uttering a word you have heard, and of disclosing secret words. Then you shall be truly modest, and you shall find favor before every man.
verses.42:1: Do not be ashamed of these things, and do not show partiality so as to sin:
verses.42:2: of the law of the Most High and the covenant, and of judgment to justify the ungodly,
verses.42:3: of settling accounts with a partner and fellow travelers, of sharing an inheritance with companions,
verses.42:4: of accuracy of scales and weights, of acquiring much and little,
verses.42:5: of impartiality in selling and with merchants, and of much discipline of children, and of making the side of a wicked servant bleed.
verses.42:6: Over a wicked wife a seal is good, and where there are many hands, lock things up.
verses.42:7: Whatever you deliver, let it be by number and weight, and let giving and receiving with everyone be in writing;
verses.42:8: of the correction of the senseless and the foolish, and of one in extreme old age contending with the young; then you shall be truly disciplined and approved before every living person.
verses.42:9: A daughter is a secret cause of wakefulness to a father, and anxiety for her drives away sleep: in her youth, lest she pass her prime, and when married, lest she be hated;
verses.42:10: in her virginity, lest she be defiled and become pregnant in her father's house; when with a husband, lest she transgress, and when married, lest she be barren.
verses.42:11: Keep a strict watch over a headstrong daughter, lest she make you a laughingstock to enemies, a byword in the city and a notoriety among the people, and put you to shame before a great multitude.
verses.42:12: Do not gaze upon any person because of beauty, and do not sit in the midst of women;
verses.42:13: for from garments comes forth a moth, and from a woman comes a woman's wickedness.
verses.42:14: Better is the wickedness of a man than a woman who does good, and a woman who brings shame leading to reproach.
verses.42:15: Now I will call to remembrance the works of the Lord, and what I have seen I will declare: by the words of the Lord are His works.
verses.42:16: The sun giving light looks down upon everything, and His work is full of His glory.
verses.42:17: The Lord has not enabled the holy ones to declare all His marvelous works, which the Lord Almighty has established, so that the universe might stand firm in His glory.
verses.42:18: He has searched out the abyss and the heart, and upon their subtle devices I have pondered; for the Lord knows all knowledge, and He looks upon the sign of the age,
verses.42:19: declaring the things that are past and the things that are to come, and uncovering the traces of hidden things.
verses.42:20: No thought has escaped Him, and not a single word has been hidden from Him.
verses.42:21: He has set in order the mighty works of His wisdom; and while He exists from before the age and forever, He has neither been increased nor diminished, and He has had no need of any counselor.
verses.42:22: How desirable are all His works, and how like a spark they are to behold!
verses.42:23: All these things live and abide forever for every need, and all things obey.
verses.42:24: All things are twofold, one opposite the other, and He has made nothing incomplete.
verses.42:25: One thing establishes the good things of the other, and who shall be satisfied with beholding His glory?
verses.43:1: The pride of the height is the firmament of purity, the appearance of heaven in a vision of glory.
verses.43:2: The sun in its appearing, proclaiming at its going forth, is a marvelous vessel, the work of the Most High.
verses.43:3: At its midday it parches the land, and before its burning heat who shall stand?
verses.43:4: One tending a furnace is in works of heat, yet threefold does the sun burn up the mountains; breathing forth fiery vapors, and flashing forth rays, it dims the eyes.
verses.43:5: Great is the Lord who made it, and by His words He hastened its course.
verses.43:6: And the moon also is in all things for its season, a showing forth of times and a sign of the age.
verses.43:7: From the moon is the sign of the feast, a luminary waning at its completion.
verses.43:8: The month is according to its name, increasing marvelously in its changing; a vessel of parables in the height, shining forth in the firmament of heaven.
verses.43:9: The beauty of heaven, the glory of the stars, an illuminating adornment; in the highest places is the Lord.
verses.43:10: By holy words they shall stand according to decree, and they shall never grow faint in their watches.
verses.43:11: Look upon the rainbow, and bless Him who made it, exceedingly fair in its radiance.
verses.43:12: It has encircled heaven in a circuit of glory; the hands of the Most High stretched it out.
verses.43:13: By His command He caused the snow to rest, and He hastens the lightnings of His judgment.
verses.43:14: Therefore the storehouses were opened, and clouds flew forth like birds.
verses.43:15: In His majesty He strengthened the clouds, and the hailstones were broken in pieces.
verses.43:16: And at His appearings the mountains shall be shaken; at His will the south wind shall blow.
verses.43:17: The voice of His thunder reproached the earth, as did the tempest of the north and the whirling of the wind. Like birds flying down, He scatters the snow, and its descent is like the locust settling down.
verses.43:18: At the beauty of its whiteness the eye shall marvel, and at its shower the heart shall be astonished.
verses.43:19: Hoarfrost also He pours out like salt upon the earth, and when it is frozen, it becomes points of thorns.
verses.43:20: The cold north wind shall blow, and ice shall be congealed from the water; upon every gathering of water it shall abide, and the water shall clothe itself as with a breastplate.
verses.43:21: It shall devour the mountains and burn up the wilderness, and extinguish the green grass like fire.
verses.43:22: A mist is a speedy healing of all things; dew coming after the scorching heat shall bring cheer.
verses.43:23: By His counsel He stilled the deep, and Jesus planted it.
verses.43:24: Those who sail the sea tell of its peril, and at the hearing of our ears we marvel.
verses.43:25: And there are the strange and wondrous works, a variety of every living creature, the creation of sea monsters.
verses.43:26: Because of Him His end is a sweet fragrance, and by His word all things consist.
verses.43:27: We shall say many things, and yet never reach the end; and the sum of our words is, "He is the all."
verses.43:28: In glorifying Him, where shall we find strength? For He Himself is great above all His works.
verses.43:29: Awesome is the Lord and exceedingly great, and marvelous is His power.
verses.43:30: As you glorify the Lord, exalt Him as much as you are able, for He shall surpass even that; and as you exalt Him, increase in strength; do not grow weary, for you shall never reach the end.
verses.43:31: Who has seen Him and shall declare Him? And who shall magnify Him as He is?
verses.43:32: Many hidden things are greater than these, for we have seen but a few of His works.
verses.43:33: For the Lord has made all things, and to the godly He has given wisdom.
verses.44:1: A Hymn of the Fathers. Let us now praise glorious men, and our fathers in their lineage.
verses.44:2: Great glory the Lord created, His majesty from eternity.
verses.44:3: Those ruling in their kingdoms, and men of renown in power; they shall give counsel in their understanding, having declared things in prophecies;
verses.44:4: leaders of the people by counsels, and by understanding of the learning of the people; wise were the words in their instruction;
verses.44:5: those searching out melodies of music, and setting forth verses in writing;
verses.44:6: rich men furnished with strength, living peaceably in their habitations.
verses.44:7: All these were honored in their generations, and were a boast in their days.
verses.44:8: There are some of them who left behind a name, so that praises might be declared.
verses.44:9: And there are some of whom there is no memorial, and they perished as though they had never existed, and became as though they had never been born, and their children after them.
verses.44:10: Yet these were men of mercy, whose righteous deeds have not been forgotten.
verses.44:11: With their seed shall abide a good inheritance, even their offspring; in the covenants
verses.44:12: their seed stood firm, and their children for their sake.
verses.44:13: Their seed shall abide forever, and their glory shall not be blotted out.
verses.44:14: Their bodies were buried in peace, and their name lives through generations.
verses.44:15: Peoples shall declare their wisdom, and the assembly proclaims their praise.
verses.44:16: Enoch pleased the Lord and was taken up, an example of repentance to the generations.
verses.44:17: Noah was found perfect and righteous; in the time of wrath he became a ransom; therefore a remnant was left to the earth; therefore the flood came.
verses.44:18: Everlasting covenants were established with him, that all flesh should not be blotted out by a flood.
verses.44:19: Abraham was a great father of a multitude of nations, and no one was found like him in glory,
verses.44:20: who kept the law of the Most High, and entered into covenant with Him; and in his flesh he established the covenant, and in testing he was found faithful.
verses.44:21: Therefore with an oath He assured him that the nations would be blessed in his seed, that He would multiply him like the dust of the earth, and exalt his seed like the stars, and cause them to inherit from sea to sea, and from the river to the end of the earth.
verses.44:22: And in Isaac He likewise established, for the sake of Abraham his father, the blessing of all men and the covenant,
verses.44:23: and He caused them to rest upon the head of Jacob; He acknowledged him in His blessings, and gave it to him as an inheritance; and He divided his portions, and distributed them among twelve tribes.
verses.45:1: And He brought forth from him a man of mercy, finding favor in the eyes of all flesh, beloved by God and men—Moses, whose memorial is in blessings.
verses.45:2: He made him equal in glory to the holy ones, and magnified him in the terrors of enemies.
verses.45:3: By his words he caused signs to cease; He glorified him in the presence of kings; He gave him commandments for His people, and showed him of His glory.
verses.45:4: In his faithfulness and meekness He sanctified him; He chose him out of all flesh.
verses.45:5: He caused him to hear His voice, and led him into the thick darkness, and gave him commandments face to face, a law of life and knowledge, to teach Jacob a covenant, and His judgments to Israel.
verses.45:6: He exalted Aaron, a holy man like him, his brother, of the tribe of Levi.
verses.45:7: He appointed him to an everlasting covenant, and gave him the priesthood of the people; He blessed him with stately adornment, and girded him with a robe of glory.
verses.45:8: He clothed him with the perfection of splendor, and strengthened him with emblems of might: the linen breeches, and the full-length robe, and the ephod.
verses.45:9: And He encircled him with pomegranates, and with very many golden bells all around, to ring out a sound at his footsteps, to make the chime heard in the temple for a memorial to the sons of His people;
verses.45:10: with a holy garment, with gold and blue and purple, works of an embroiderer, with the breastpiece of judgment, with the manifestations of truth,
verses.45:11: with spun scarlet, the work of a craftsman, with precious stones of seal engraving in a setting of gold, works of a jeweler, for a memorial in carved inscription according to the number of the tribes of Israel;
verses.45:12: and a crown of gold upon the turban, an engraved seal of holiness, a splendor of honor, a work of might, delights of the eyes richly adorned, things of beauty.
verses.45:13: Before him there had never been such things; forever no outsider has put them on, except his sons only, and his descendants continually.
verses.45:14: His sacrifice shall be wholly consumed every day continually, twice.
verses.45:15: Moses filled his hands and anointed him with holy oil; it became to him an everlasting covenant, and to his seed for the days of heaven, to minister to Him and also to serve in the priesthood, and to bless His people in the Name.
verses.45:16: He chose him out of every living person, to offer sacrifice to the Lord, incense and a sweet aroma for a memorial, to make atonement for your people.
verses.45:17: He placed him over His commandments, giving authority in covenants of judgments, to teach Jacob the testimonies, and in His law to proclaim to Israel.
verses.45:18: Outsiders conspired together against him and envied him in the wilderness—the men who were with Dathan and Abiram, and the assembly of Korah, in wrath and anger.
verses.45:19: The Lord saw it and was not pleased, and they were consumed in the fury of wrath; He performed wonders upon them, to consume them in the fire of His flame.
verses.45:20: And He added glory to Aaron, and gave him an inheritance; He apportioned to them the firstfruits of the first produce, and in the first place He prepared bread in abundance.
verses.45:21: For indeed they shall eat the sacrifices of the Lord, which He gave both to him and to his seed.
verses.45:22: Yet in the land of the people he shall not inherit, and he has no portion among the people; for He Himself is your portion and inheritance.
verses.45:23: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar is third in glory, because he was zealous in the fear of the Lord, and stood firm when the people turned away, in the goodness of the readiness of his soul; and he made atonement for Israel.
verses.45:24: Therefore a covenant of peace was established with him, that he should be guardian of the sanctuary and of his people, so that to him and to his seed might belong the majesty of the priesthood forever.
verses.45:25: And a covenant was made with David, a son of the tribe of Judah: the inheritance of the king passes from son to son alone, whereas the inheritance of Aaron belongs also to his seed.
verses.45:26: May He give you wisdom in your heart to judge His people in righteousness, so that their good things may not perish, and their glory may endure throughout their generations.
verses.46:1: Mighty in wars was Joshua the son of Nun, and the successor of Moses in prophecies, who became, according to his name, great for the salvation of His chosen ones, to execute vengeance upon enemies who rose up, so that he might give Israel their inheritance.
verses.46:2: How glorified he was when he lifted up his hands and turned the sword against cities!
verses.46:3: Who before him stood so firm? For the Lord Himself brought the enemies forward.
verses.46:4: Did not the sun turn back by his hand, and did not one day become as two?
verses.46:5: He called upon the Most High Mighty One when enemies pressed him hard on every side, and the great Lord answered them,
verses.46:6: with hailstones of mighty power. He hurled down battle upon the nation, and at the descent He destroyed those who withstood them, so that the nations might know their full armor, that his war was before the Lord; for indeed he followed after the Mighty One.
verses.46:7: And in the days of Moses he showed mercy, he and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, by standing against the enemy, restraining the people from sin, and quieting the murmuring of wickedness.
verses.46:8: And these two alone were preserved out of six hundred thousand men on foot, to lead them into their inheritance, into a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.46:9: And the Lord gave strength to Caleb, and it remained with him until old age, so that he ascended the heights of the land, and his seed took possession of an inheritance,
verses.46:10: so that all the sons of Israel might see that it is good to walk after the Lord.
verses.46:11: And the judges also, each by his own name, all whose heart did not play the harlot and all who did not turn away from the Lord—may their memorial be in blessings.
verses.46:12: May their bones flourish again from their resting place, and may their name be renewed upon the sons of those glorified among them.
verses.46:13: Beloved by his Lord, the prophet of the Lord established a king and anointed rulers over His people.
verses.46:14: By the law of the Lord he judged the congregation, and the Lord visited Jacob.
verses.46:15: By his faithfulness he was proved a true prophet, and in his faithfulness he was known to be trustworthy in vision.
verses.46:16: And he called upon the Lord, the Mighty One, when his enemies pressed him on every side, with the offering of a nursing lamb.
verses.46:17: And the Lord thundered from heaven, and with a great sound He made His voice heard,
verses.46:18: and He crushed the leaders of the Tyrians and all the rulers of the Philistines.
verses.46:19: And before the time of his eternal sleep, he bore witness before the Lord and the anointed one: "Wealth, even down to sandals, I have not taken from any flesh." And no man accused him.
verses.46:20: And after he had fallen asleep, he prophesied and declared to the king his end; and he lifted up his voice from the earth in prophecy, to blot out the iniquity of the people.
verses.47:1: And after him Nathan arose to prophesy in the days of David.
verses.47:2: As the fat set apart from the peace offering, so was David from the sons of Israel.
verses.47:3: He played with lions as with young goats, and with bears as with lambs of the flock.
verses.47:4: In his youth did he not slay a giant, and remove reproach from the people, when he lifted up his hand with a slingstone and cast down the boasting of Goliath?
verses.47:5: For he called upon the Lord, the Most High, and He gave strength to his right hand to strike down a man in war; He shall exalt the horn of His people.
verses.47:6: Thus He glorified him for ten thousands, and praised him with the blessings of the Lord, when a diadem of glory was brought to him.
verses.47:7: For he crushed enemies on every side, and brought to nothing the Philistines, the adversaries; even to this day he shattered their horn.
verses.47:8: In every work of his he gave thanksgiving to the Holy One, the Most High, with a word of glory; with all his heart he sang praises and loved Him who made him.
verses.47:9: And he placed psalm-singers before the altar, to make sweet melodies by their sound.
verses.47:10: He gave splendor to the feasts and adorned the appointed seasons to perfection, while they praised His holy name and the sanctuary resounded from early morning.
verses.47:11: The Lord took away his sins and exalted his horn forever, and gave him a covenant of kings and a throne of glory in Israel.
verses.47:12: After him arose a son of understanding, and for his sake he dwelt in a broad place.
verses.47:13: Solomon reigned in days of peace, to whom God gave rest on every side, that he might establish a house in His name and prepare a sanctuary forever.
verses.47:14: How wise you became in your youth, and you were filled like a river with understanding!
verses.47:15: Your soul covered the earth, and you filled it with parables of riddles.
verses.47:16: Your name reached distant islands, and you were beloved in your peace.
verses.47:17: For songs and proverbs and parables, and for interpretation, the lands marveled at you.
verses.47:18: In the name of the Lord God, who is called the God of Israel, you gathered gold like tin, and you multiplied silver like lead.
verses.47:19: You laid your loins beside women, and you were brought under dominion in your body.
verses.47:20: You brought a blemish upon your glory and profaned your seed, so as to bring wrath upon your children, and I was grieved over your folly,
verses.47:21: so that the sovereignty was divided in two, and out of Ephraim a disobedient kingdom began to rule.
verses.47:22: Yet the Lord will by no means forsake His mercy, nor shall any of His works perish; neither will He blot out the descendants of His chosen one, nor will He take away the seed of him who loved Him; and to Jacob He gave a remnant, and to David a root from himself.
verses.47:23: And Solomon rested with the fathers, and left after him from his seed the folly of the people and one lacking in understanding, Rehoboam, who caused the people to revolt by his counsel; and Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin and gave Ephraim a way of sin.
verses.47:24: And their sins were multiplied exceedingly, so as to remove them from their land;
verses.47:25: and they sought out every wickedness, until vengeance should come upon them.
verses.48:1: And Elijah the prophet arose like fire, and his word burned like a torch.
verses.48:2: He brought a famine upon them, and by his zeal he made them few in number.
verses.48:3: By the word of the Lord he held back heaven, and thus three times he brought down fire.
verses.48:4: How you were glorified, O Elijah, in your wondrous deeds! And who can boast like you?
verses.48:5: He who raised up a dead man from death and from Hades by the word of the Most High;
verses.48:6: who brought kings down to destruction, and men of renown from their bed;
verses.48:7: who heard reproof at Sinai, and judgments of vengeance at Horeb;
verses.48:8: who anointed kings for retribution, and prophets as successors after him;
verses.48:9: who was taken up in a whirlwind of fire, in a chariot of fiery horses;
verses.48:10: who was recorded in reproofs for appointed times, to appease wrath before fury, and to turn the heart of a father to a son, and to restore the tribes of Jacob.
verses.48:11: Blessed are those who saw you and those who have been adorned in love, for we also shall surely live.
verses.48:12: Elijah was covered in a whirlwind, and Elisha was filled with his spirit; in his days he was not shaken by any ruler, and no one overpowered him.
verses.48:13: No matter was too great for him, and in sleep his body prophesied.
verses.48:14: In his life he performed wonders, and in death his works were marvelous.
verses.48:15: In all these things the people did not repent, and they did not depart from their sins, until they were carried off as plunder from their land and scattered throughout all the earth; and the people were left very few in number, yet with a ruler for the house of David.
verses.48:16: Some of them did what was pleasing, while others multiplied sins.
verses.48:17: Hezekiah fortified his city and brought Gog into their midst; he hewed the hard rock with iron and built cisterns for waters.
verses.48:18: In his days Sennacherib came up and sent Rabshakeh, and departed; and his hand was lifted up against Zion, and he boasted greatly in his arrogance.
verses.48:19: Then their hearts and hands were shaken, and they suffered anguish like women in labor.
verses.48:20: And they called upon the Lord, the Merciful One, stretching out their hands toward Him; and the Holy One swiftly heard them from heaven and delivered them by the hand of Isaiah.
verses.48:21: He struck the camp of the Assyrians, and His angel wiped them out.
verses.48:22: For Hezekiah did what was pleasing to the Lord and stood firm in the ways of David his father, which Isaiah the prophet commanded, who was great and faithful in his vision.
verses.48:23: In his days the sun went backward, and he added life to the king.
verses.48:24: By a mighty spirit he saw the last things, and he comforted those who mourned in Zion.
verses.48:25: He revealed the things that were to come even to the end of the age, and the hidden things before they came to pass.
verses.49:1: The remembrance of Josiah is like a blending of incense, prepared by the work of a perfumer; in every mouth it shall be sweet as honey, and like music at a banquet of wine.
verses.49:2: He was directed aright in the turning back of the people, and he removed the abominations of lawlessness.
verses.49:3: He directed his heart toward the Lord; in the days of lawless men he strengthened godliness.
verses.49:4: Except for David and Hezekiah and Josiah, all committed grave trespass; for they forsook the law of the Most High, and the kings of Judah came to an end.
verses.49:5: For they gave their horn to others, and their glory to a foreign nation.
verses.49:6: They burned the chosen city of the sanctuary and made her streets desolate, by the hand of Jeremiah;
verses.49:7: for they afflicted him, though he was sanctified in the womb as a prophet, to root out and to afflict and to destroy, and likewise to build and to plant.
verses.49:8: It was Ezekiel who saw a vision of glory, which He showed him upon a chariot of cherubim;
verses.49:9: for indeed he remembered the enemies in a rainstorm, and to do good to those who make their ways straight.
verses.49:10: And may the bones of the twelve prophets flourish again from their place; for He comforted Jacob and redeemed them in faithful hope.
verses.49:11: How shall we magnify Zerubbabel? Even he is like a signet ring upon the right hand.
verses.49:12: So also was Joshua the son of Jozadak, who in their days built the house and exalted a holy people to the Lord, prepared for everlasting glory.
verses.49:13: And far and wide they bestow the remembrance of him who raised up for us the fallen walls, and set up gates and bars, and rebuilt our ruins.
verses.49:14: Not even one was created upon the earth such as Enoch, for he indeed was taken up from the earth.
verses.49:15: And Joseph was born a man, a leader of brethren, a support of the people, and his bones were cared for.
verses.49:16: Shem and Seth were glorified among men, and above every living creature in creation was Adam.
verses.50:1: Simon the son of Onias was the high priest, who in his life repaired the house and in his days strengthened the temple.
verses.50:2: And by him was laid the foundation of the lofty double wall, the high retaining wall of the temple precinct.
verses.50:3: In his days the reservoir of waters was diminished, bronze like the sea in its circumference.
verses.50:4: He cared for his people against downfall and fortified the city to withstand siege.
verses.50:5: How he was glorified when surrounded by the people, as he came forth from the house of the veil!
verses.50:6: Like the morning star in the midst of a cloud, like the full moon in its days;
verses.50:7: like the sun shining forth upon the temple of the Most High, and like the rainbow gleaming in clouds of glory;
verses.50:8: like the blossom of roses in the days of new growth, like lilies by the streams of water, like a shoot of Lebanon in the days of summer;
verses.50:9: like fire and frankincense upon the censer, like a vessel of solid beaten gold adorned with every precious stone;
verses.50:10: like an olive tree putting forth fruit, and like a cypress towering into the clouds.
verses.50:11: When he put on the robe of glory and clothed himself in the perfection of splendor, as he ascended to the holy altar, he made glorious the enclosure of the sanctuary.
verses.50:12: And when he received the portions from the hands of the priests, while standing himself by the hearth of the altar, with a garland of brethren all around him, he was like a young cedar in Lebanon, and they encircled him like trunks of palm trees.
verses.50:13: And all the sons of Aaron were in their glory, with the offering of the Lord in their hands before the whole assembly of Israel.
verses.50:14: And completing the service at the altars, to arrange the offering of the Most High, the Almighty,
verses.50:15: he stretched out his hand to the libation cup and poured a drink offering of the blood of the grape; he poured it out at the foundations of the altar, a sweet-smelling aroma to the Most High, the King of all.
verses.50:16: Then the sons of Aaron shouted aloud; they sounded the trumpets of beaten work; they caused a mighty sound to be heard for a remembrance before the Most High.
verses.50:17: Then all the people hastened together and fell upon their faces to the ground to worship their Lord, the Almighty, God Most High.
verses.50:18: And the singers sang praises with their voices; throughout the vast house the melody was made sweet.
verses.50:19: And the people implored the Lord Most High in prayer before the Merciful One, until the order of the Lord was completed and they finished His service.
verses.50:20: Then he came down and lifted up his hands over the whole assembly of the sons of Israel, to give blessing to the Lord from his lips and to glory in His name.
verses.50:21: And he bowed down in worship a second time to show forth the blessing from the Most High.
verses.50:22: And now, all of you, bless God, who does great things everywhere, who exalts our days from the womb and deals with us according to His mercy.
verses.50:23: May He grant you gladness of heart, and may there be peace in our days in Israel as in the days of old.
verses.50:24: May His mercy abide faithfully with us, and in His days may He redeem us.
verses.50:25: My soul abhors two nations, and the third is not a nation:
verses.50:26: those who sit on the mountain of Samaria, the Philistines, and the foolish people who dwell in Shechem.
verses.50:27: Instruction in understanding and knowledge I have inscribed in this book, I, Jesus the son of Sirach Eleazar of Jerusalem, who poured forth wisdom from his heart.
verses.50:28: Blessed is he who shall walk in these things, and he who lays them upon his heart shall become wise.
verses.50:29: For if he does them, he shall be strong for all things; for the light of the Lord is his path.
verses.51:1: A Prayer of Jesus, the son of Sirach. I will give thanks to You, O Lord, King, and I will praise You, God my Savior; I give thanks to Your name,
verses.51:2: for You have become a protector and helper to me, and You have redeemed my body from destruction and from the snare of a slanderous tongue, from lips that work falsehood, and before those who stood by You became a helper,
verses.51:3: and You redeemed me, according to the abundance of Your mercy and Your name, from gnashing teeth when I was ready to become food, from the hand of those who sought my life, from the many afflictions which I endured,
verses.51:4: from the choking of a blazing fire all around, and from the midst of a fire which I did not kindle,
verses.51:5: from the depth of the belly of Hades, and from an unclean tongue and a lying word.
verses.51:6: Slander of an unrighteous tongue before a king—my soul gave praise even to death, and my life was near to Hades below.
verses.51:7: They surrounded me on every side, and there was no one to help; I looked for the support of men, and there was none.
verses.51:8: Then I remembered Your mercy, O Lord, and Your work from of old, that You will deliver those who wait for You, and You save them from the hand of the nations.
verses.51:9: And I lifted up my supplication upon the earth, and I pleaded for deliverance from death.
verses.51:10: I called upon the Lord, the Father of my lord, not to forsake me in the days of affliction, in the time of arrogance and helplessness. I will praise Your name continually, and I will sing hymns in thanksgiving. And my prayer was heard.
verses.51:12: For You saved me from destruction and delivered me from an evil time; therefore I will give thanks and praise You, and I will bless the name of the Lord.
verses.51:13: While I was still young, before I wandered, I sought wisdom openly in my prayer.
verses.51:14: Before the temple I prayed for her, and to the very end I will seek her out.
verses.51:15: From the blossom, as of a ripening grape, my heart rejoiced in her; my foot trod in uprightness, and from my youth I followed her tracks.
verses.51:16: I inclined my ear a little and received her, and I found for myself much instruction.
verses.51:17: Progress came to me through her; to Him who gives me wisdom I will give glory.
verses.51:18: For I resolved to practice her, and I was zealous for what is good, and I shall never be put to shame.
verses.51:19: My soul has wrestled for her, and in the practice of hunger I was scrupulous; I stretched out my hands on high, and I lamented my ignorance of her.
verses.51:20: I directed my soul toward her, I gained a heart with them from the beginning, and in purification I found her; therefore I shall never be forsaken.
